strata.f03Note: not a paired test: date-confounded; before M366 the speed, SoC and engine-speed columns of the then hash-failing raw/ files were cell-identical to the sha256-verified originals and their HV current and voltage were rounded (effect computed in the read-only comparison, f03SpeedHvCheck); raw/ now holds the originals

chargingSubState.note: fuel consumed during net pack charging: a temporal state, not a fuel-source allocation; battery offset is estimated; all trips are now on the sha256-verified originals and the strata keep the former re-export split for sensitivity; the former re-export trips had rounded raw/ current before M366 (effect on pack energy computed in the read-only comparison, f03SpeedHvCheck)

f03SpeedHvCheck.scope: 333 canonical files that were hash-failing before M366: raw/ copy vs sha256-verified original, read-only comparison (owner-approved 2026-10-03) run before raw/ was overwritten (M366)

definitions.dwell: a stationary run is stationary only if the SUM of its capped interval durations is >= 5 s (the audit's alternative, last minus first sample time, gives 1.92% instead of 1.98% at 1 km/h)
definitions.clock: each interval is owned by its END sample (backward dt, capped at 5 s); the state is taken at that sample
definitions.speedPriority: VCM speed if it has >= 20 native samples, else the OBD channel (project-wide rule); nearest sample within 1.5 s

fuelStates._provenance: GENERATED by tools/fuel_analytics2.py (M339). Do not hand-edit.
fuelStates.basis: logged/app-calculated fuel rate (Car Scanner ELM OBD2); raw/ = sha256-verified originals (M366); not M299-reproducible; temporal states, associations only
fuelStates.method: day-clustered percentile bootstrap (seed 42, 4000 draws), ratio-of-sums; interval only with >= 10 trips and >= 7 distinct days at a position (shares: >= 7 days; 5-6 low-cluster; < 5 points only)

fuelWarmup.alignment: first rate sample with rpm > 400 and rate > 0 inside the counter window (left-censored trips excluded and counted)

bands.oil-fallback: initial temperature from oil (fallback; separate stratum)

fuelWarmup.pointwiseNote: CIs are pointwise (day-clustered bootstrap), not simultaneous bands

definitions.intervalOwnership: a sample belongs to the 0.5 km interval (lo, hi] of its END-sample cumulative distance since t0; the sample that crosses hi belongs to the next interval; only completed intervals count (contribution ends at a rate gap > 5 s or an unknown-speed sample). The blind audit's alternative (crossing sample handled differently, no unknown-speed censoring) gives 15.98 L/100 km (49 trips) instead of 16.08 (48) in the >= 60 C band: a method disagreement of 0.1 L/100 km and one trip, not tuned away.
